Name: Golden Scythe Rename - for Content Patcher
Author: Sparrowstorm
Description:
This mod simply renames the Golden Scythe to the more generic name of "Big Scythe" so it matches better with my personal suite of mods, including recolours for tools such as the Golden Scythe.

I made this for my personal use but I decided to upload it to the Nexus since I couldn't find a similar mod already up.
